programme.title: The Enormity Of Life

programme.title: Sorority Secrets
programme.desc: When Sorority sisters start dying, one member takes is upon herself to get to the bottom of the mystery.

programme.title: Full Out 2: You Got This!
programme.desc: When the University of Oklahoma Sooners lose their star gymnast, Brenna Dowell, the rest of the team have to find a way to believe in themselves in order to win their second National Gymnastics Championship. With the help of Riley, a local breakdancing phenomenon, Chayse and her OU teammates learn to incorporate intricate breakdance techniques into their gymnastics routines in order to find a competitive edge. At the end of it all, they realize what matters most is finding the confidence to believe in yourself.

programme.title: Equal Standard
programme.desc: The lives of New York City police officers collide with interwoven stories of race, rank, loss and betrayal.

programme.title: First Love
programme.desc: The story is described as a poignant look at a young man's difficult entry into adulthood.

programme.title: Damascena: The Transition
programme.desc: This biographical drama follows the life of Techo - one of the biggest rose oil producers in Bulgaria nowadays and depicts the collision between his dream and the harsh political and social reality in Bulgaria during the past fifty years.

programme.title: Legendary Voyages
programme.desc: Legendary Voyages

programme.title: Mall
programme.desc: Mall follows the interconnected stories of several individuals whose ordinary lives collide at a suburban shopping mall. As each character grapples with personal isolation, emotional conflict, and dissatisfaction, a shocking act of violence changes their lives forever. Through multiple perspectives, the film explores alienation, consumer culture, and the consequences of despair in modern society.

programme.title: Nightmare Alley: Possession
programme.desc: A grifter working his way up from low-ranking carnival worker to lauded psychic medium matches wits with a psychologist bent on exposing him.

programme.title: Romantic Rewrite
programme.desc: A romance editor tries to help a mystery writer incorporate romance into his next book. In return, he agrees to be her fake date for her sister's beach wedding.

programme.title: Peter Bell 2: The Czar Crown
programme.desc: Pietje Bell is jailed for theft but escapes to prove his innocence. He battles crime boss Stark and, with his gang, tries to stop a daring crown heist.

programme.title: Where Is Kyra
programme.desc: Where Is Kyra? follows Kyra Johnson, a middle-aged woman who moves back in with her ailing mother after losing her job and going through a difficult divorce. As her financial situation worsens, Kyra begins making risky choices to survive while trying to maintain a sense of stability and dignity. Her relationship with a mysterious man brings temporary comfort, but her growing desperation leads her into a dark and uncertain path. The film explores loneliness, economic struggle, identity, and the emotional impact of hardship.

programme.title: Drive Hard
programme.desc: A former race car driver is abducted by a mysterious thief and forced to be the wheel-man for a crime that puts them both in the sights of the cops and the mob.

programme.title: Where Eskimos Live

They embark upon a strange and enlightening journey through war torn Bosnia. As they struggle to get out of the country and fight to stay alive, they find a special love and compassion from which emerges their ultimate moral and spiritual redemption.

programme.title: The Thin Line

programme.title: Hero Dog: The Journey Home
programme.desc: When unexpected circumstances separate a loyal dog from its owners, an extraordinary adventure begins. Determined to find the way home, the dog navigates rugged landscapes, encounters both danger and kindness, and discovers the true meaning of courage, friendship, and perseverance. Filled with heartfelt moments and inspiring encounters, Hero Dog: The Journey Home is a touching family adventure celebrating the unbreakable bond between humans and their canine companions.

programme.title: Mad Genius
programme.desc: Mason Wells, a gifted but unconventional programmer, creates a groundbreaking device capable of connecting human minds within a shared subconscious world. As the technology attracts the attention of influential figures with hidden agendas, Mason finds himself caught in a dangerous struggle where reality becomes increasingly uncertain. Combining science fiction, psychological suspense, and philosophical questions about consciousness and free will, Mad Genius explores the consequences of innovation when imagination and reality collide.

programme.title: A Monster In Paris

programme.title: Konosuba S2, Ep 9
programme.desc: High school student Kazuma Satou dies in an unexpectedly embarrassing accident and awakens in the presence of the goddess Aqua. She offers him the opportunity to be reincarnated in a fantasy world to defeat the Demon King. Before leaving, Kazuma is allowed to take one item with him, and he mischievously chooses Aqua herself. Together, the unlikely pair begin their new life in another world, quickly discovering that surviving there is far more difficult than they imagined. Filled with humor, fantasy, and parody, the episode introduces the eccentric characters and comedic adventures that define the series.

programme.title: Blessing Of Formosa
programme.desc: Blessing of Formosa is a cultural travel program produced by Sanlih E-Television that celebrates the beauty of Taiwan's folk beliefs and traditions. Each episode takes viewers to renowned temples, religious celebrations, and historic communities, introducing local customs, handicrafts, traditional festivals, folklore, and stories of deities. Combining travel, history, culture, and entertainment, the program offers an engaging journey into Taiwan's rich spiritual and cultural heritage while promoting local tourism and preserving traditional folk culture.

programme.title: Show Biz
programme.desc: Show Biz delivers comprehensive coverage of the entertainment world through the latest celebrity news, exclusive interviews, behind-the-scenes features, and updates on movies, television, music, and lifestyle. The program also highlights upcoming events, industry trends, and inspiring stories from artists and entertainers, providing viewers with a complete overview of the entertainment scene.

programme.title: The Borderless World
programme.desc: The Borderless World is a news magazine program that delivers in-depth reports on international affairs, global trends, and human-interest stories. Covering topics such as politics, business, technology, culture, and social issues, the program highlights how events around the world influence people's lives while presenting unique Taiwanese perspectives on international developments.

programme.title: Mr. Player
programme.desc: Mr. Player follows Pun, who returns to Thailand after her fiancé disappears with her savings. Determined to find him, she approaches Ploy, a successful actress and the fugitive's sister, hoping to uncover his whereabouts. As their relationship grows more complicated, secrets, deception, and unexpected romance emerge, forcing both women to confront the truth while navigating danger, betrayal, and their evolving feelings for one another.

programme.title: Flavor Of Life
programme.desc: At 40, Han Xiao leaves her dream job to reopen her parents' canteen. Her father's return with dementia forces the family to confront old wounds and learn how to rebuild their lives together.

programme.desc: A Culinary Journey takes viewers on a flavorful exploration of diverse culinary traditions across different regions. programme.title: Stylish Man: The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man: The Chef is one of Taiwan's most popular cooking variety shows, produced by Sanlih E-Television. Hosted by Sam Tseng and Genie Chuo alongside renowned chefs James and Wu Bing-Cheng, the program blends cooking demonstrations with celebrity competitions, themed culinary challenges, and humorous studio interactions. Viewers can learn practical recipes, professional cooking techniques, and kitchen tips while enjoying lighthearted entertainment and appearances by popular Taiwanese celebrities.

programme.title: Battle Tour
programme.desc: Battle Tour is a travel reality program where celebrity teams design and experience travel itineraries based on different themes and budgets. Throughout each episode, the teams visit popular attractions, discover hidden gems, enjoy local cuisine, and share practical travel tips. At the end of the journey, a panel and audience determine which itinerary offers the most memorable and worthwhile travel experience.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Produced by Sanlih E-Television, Hot Door Night is a long-running variety program hosted by Jacky Wu alongside Chen Han-Dian and Lulu Huang. Each episode features celebrity guests competing in creative games, themed challenges, comedy segments, musical performances, and entertaining talk sessions. Blending humor, competition, and pop culture, the show has become one of Taiwan's highest-rated entertainment programs and has received multiple Golden Bell Award nominations and wins.

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness follows the Wu family, led by a respected police officer and his supportive wife. Although he once dreamed of having a son to continue the family legacy, he instead dedicates his life to guiding his four daughters through the joys and hardships of adulthood. As their lives become intertwined with romance, ambition, betrayal, and family rivalries, the family faces countless trials that test their love and resilience. Blending heartfelt relationships with dramatic twists, the series delivers an emotional story about family bonds, forgiveness, and perseverance.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan
programme.desc: Discover the fascinating traditions and folklore of Taiwan in The Tradition Story of Taiwan. Each episode delves into ancient legends, local customs, religious beliefs, historical figures, and cultural practices that continue to shape Taiwanese identity today. Combining storytelling with visits to historical sites and local communities, the program offers viewers an engaging journey through Taiwan's diverse cultural heritage and enduring traditions.
